content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any project documents that define the allocated trigger rate, latency estimates/measurements, and threshold rules. Extract the three allowed algorithm names, their Level-1 FPGA latencies, and the allocated rate condition."},{"id":"s2","description":"Apply the hard constraints from the documents to the three candidates: keep only algorithms with documented latency <= 4.0 us and compatible threshold range 20–60 GeV. Record the numeric latency for each candidate using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each latency-eligible candidate, run simulate_efficiency at a coarse set of thresholds across 20–60 GeV, e.g. 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, and 60 GeV. Record each numeric efficiency result with record_results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify, for each candidate, the threshold region giving the highest signal efficiency while satisfying the allocated trigger rate as returned by simulate_efficiency. If needed, run additional simulations in 1–2 GeV increments around the best coarse threshold for each viable candidate, and record the numeric efficiencies."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the single algorithm and threshold with the highest simulated signal efficiency among candidates satisfying all hard requirements: listed in candidate_specs.md, latency <= 4.0 us, threshold 20–60 GeV, and efficiency >= 80% at the allocated rate. Prepare the selected numeric threshold, efficiency, and latency for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Algorithm-L1","threshold_gev":37,"justification":"Algorithm-L1 at 37 GeV gives the highest simulated signal efficiency found at the allocated 8 kHz rate: 93.887%, exceeding the 80% hard efficiency requirement and outperforming Algorithm-L3's best refined point of 86.445% and Algorithm-L2's 75.478%. The threshold is within the allowed 20–60 GeV range and Algorithm-L1 is one of the allowed candidates. However, no Level-1 FPGA latency values were found in the project documents for any candidate, so the 4.0 us hard latency requirement cannot be verified; the recorded selection_valid flag is therefore false and no candidate is confirmed to satisfy all hard requirements. This recommendation is the best physics-performance choice, conditional on latency documentation/measurement confirming latency <= 4.0 us before deployment.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Use one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Algorithm_L1_allowed = 1; all three candidate algorithms were marked allowed."},{"requirement":"Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.","status":"met","evidence":"At allocated_rate_khz = 8, the best refined result is Algorithm-L1 at 37 GeV with 93.887% efficiency; Algorithm-L3 best is 86.445% at 41 GeV and Algorithm-L2 best is 75.478% at 32 GeV."},{"requirement":"Signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.","status":"met","evidence":"Algorithm_L1_best_refined_efficiency_pct = 93.887, so Algorithm_L1_meets_80pct_efficiency_requirement = 1."},{"requirement":"Algorithm latency on Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.","status":"unknown","evidence":"latency_values_found_in_documents = 0; Algorithm_L1_latency_documented = 0; Algorithm_L1_latency_us = -1; no candidate was confirmed to pass the latency constraint and num_candidates_satisfying_all_hard_requirements = 0."},{"requirement":"Threshold between 20 and 60 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended threshold is 37 GeV, within threshold_min_gev = 20 and threshold_max_gev = 60; Algorithm_L1_threshold_range_compatible = 1."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted Algorithm-L1 with threshold_gev = 37."}]}
